_note: Numbered document series (decision 167, made generic by decision 182). A case type configures, per series, the prefix printed in front of the running number: documentSeries.<series>.prefix, e.g. {"beschikking": {"prefix": "B"}}. The number itself is one running count per series, per organisation, per year, issued by DocumentSeriesNumberer; a series the case type does not configure prints the issuing code's default. Declared on caseType because OpenRegister's magic mapper stores no undeclared key. A series can also number the documents of one set (a dossier, an inventory, an export): order (sort keys, first key first, ties keep their input order), width (zero-padded digits) and gapPolicy (renumber: 1..n on every listing; keep: a number once given stays with its document), read by DocumentSetNumberer.

documentSeries.title: Document numbering
documentSeries.description: Per kind of document, the letters printed before its number, for example B for a beschikking. The number itself counts up per organisation and starts again each year.

order.title: Order
order.description: The order the documents of one set are numbered in, first key first. Documents that are equal on every key keep the order they were read in.

width.title: Digits
width.description: How many digits a number in a set is printed with, padded with zeros.

gapPolicy.title: When a document is removed
gapPolicy.description: renumber gives the set 1, 2, 3 again; keep lets every document keep the number it was given, so a removed one leaves a gap.

numberField.title: Number field
numberField.description: The field a kept number is stored in on the document.
